text:
anya: Quick heads-up: preview invoice feed showing a spike for a few tenants after the shard-rollout. Looks like session-level double counting when route ownership flips. Not full invoices but preview doubled for some customers.

dmitri: Can you show sample payloads? curious how much info we can use to dedupe.

anya: example (sanitized):

```json
{
  "session_id": "sess-77f",
  "route": "r-west-3",
  "token_count": 400,
  "event_type": "token_batch",
  "ts": 1712354980
}
{
  "session_id": "sess-77f",
  "route": "r-east-2",
  "token_count": 400,
  "event_type": "token_batch",
  "ts": 1712354988
}
```

oscar: same session_id, different route -> tallyer treats as two sessions because ledger key = (session_id, route). that matches the symptoms.

kevin: possible fixes sorted by invasiveness:
- cheap: preview pipeline only: collapse events with same session_id within 45s window (no infra changes)
- medium: attach-only transition token emitted at route attach; ingest keeps last_attach token for session -> dedupe when overlap seen
- stronger: per-session monotonic seq in events, ledger ignores lower/equal seqs

sarah: pros/cons? Preview collapse is fast but hides per-route detail. Transition token reduces payload because we only emit on attach. seq needs durable session state on edge which is heavier.

anya: tradeoff suggestion: short-term feature-flagged preview collapse to quiet noise; parallel spike to implement attach_token + tiny TTL KV at ingest for stitching. If attach_token missing we fallback to collapse window.

dmitri: agree. also add metric instrumenting: dedupe_hits, fallback_collapses, attach_missing_rate so we can see how many events relied on grace window.

oscar: console impact: if we collapse by session_id in preview, per-route breakdown will change. product/sales will get alerts. we should surface a "route reassignments" timeline next to preview so folks can drill into why route numbers changed.

kevin: implementation plan:
- edge: emit attach_event with attach_token + prev_route (when route changes) (1 day spike)
- ingest consumer: write last_attach_token to small Redis/kv with TTL 1h on attach_event (2 days)
- preview aggregator: feature-flag collapse by session_id 45s (ship today)
- tallyer: use attach_token lookup when present, otherwise revert to seq if present, otherwise collapse window (2-3 days)

anya: security note: attach_token must be internal only. strip before any customer-visible exports. short randomness OK, doesn't need to be crypto-grade.

sarah: can we ensure attach_event is idempotent if re-sent? ingest consumer should be write-if-newer using attach ts.

dmitri: will prototype the ingest KV pattern and a small debug dashboard showing dedupe classification for last 24h.

oscar: i'll mock console card with small "why did my route numbers move" help text and a list of recent reassignments per tenant.

billing-bot: alert: preview-delta spike detected 1712354950-1712355050 for tenants t-alpha and t-gamma. link: /billing/preview/1712354950-1712355050

kevin: action items:
- dmitri/anya: spike attach_token KV + dedupe logic (PR)
- sarah: feature-flag preview collapse and metric emits (today)
- oscar: console card mock and tooltip (EOD)
- anya: collect edge logs + attach_event examples and put in the incident gist

anya: thanks all. i'll scope the preview transformation and land the feature-flag ASAP so we stop noisy alerts while we build the durable stitch.

kevin: one more ask: add a small test harness that simulates a route-change in CI for ingest pipeline so future rollouts don't regress.

anya: noted.
